answer: Randomized Audit Harvest. Each epoch, a verifiable random function (seeded by a public beacon) selects a small random subset of agents to bridge their logs into an audit pool; auditors check consistency and post an opal proof of correctness. Agents failing audit lose standing and rewards. Because selection is unpredictable before the seed, an attacker must run every sybil identity continuously with valid nectar history, paying full compute and logging costs per identity rather than only for precomputed winners.
